correctness.rationale: The claimed laws are normalized on {1,2,…}: ω(0)=0 and ω(n)→∞ for U, and each V survival factor lies in (0,1−e^(−1)) so its product tends to zero. They are not the literal inconsistent zero-plus-positive-index pmf in the reference. Log(Rθ+1) has positive first and second derivatives, so ω is strictly increasing and strictly convex and the interpolated hazard difference increases to 1−e^(−1). At x=1 equality reduces to z=e^(−z) with z=1−e^(−ω(1)); the difference there decreases strictly with α, proving the exact Lambert-W trichotomy. The survival ratio starts at one; above threshold it first increases and ultimately strictly decreases after at most one plateau at a ratio greater than one. As ω(n)∼const·e^(2θn)/n², the deficits of (1−b_n)/(1−e^(−1)) from one are summable and the limiting product lies strictly between zero and one. This gives the survival and mass equivalents, forces the ratio to zero, and proves the moment cutoffs (divergence also at equality for V). For the crossing location, xα→∞ by the fixed-x sign; the ratio ω(xα−1)/ω(xα) tends to e^(−2θ) and the scalar crossing has a continuous unique positive root there. Using Rθ(x)∼(1+θ)e^(θx)/(θx) then gives θxα=log α+log(θxα)+log(√(2wθ)/(1+θ))+o(1), first implying θxα/log α→1 and then the stated constant. This replays the estimates at positive parameters and fixed θ in the α limit; the source's floating-point check.py was inspected, not run or used to prove a limit.

value.rationale: The pair of previously motivated discretizations has a sharp order boundary that diagnoses when one lifetime is uniformly shorter and when their survival comparison must reverse. The logarithmic-plus-logarithmic delay and separation of exponential-moment domains show why the choice of discretization matters even when both start from the same continuous law. The contribution is this model-specific structural classification, not the standard product construction or correction of a normalization issue alone.
